{{Quote|Why work up a sweat when I got a mountain full o' followers t'do my punchin' for me?|Gideon Longspar|<ref name="marvel66" />}}
'''Gideon Longspar''' was a [[Warlord/Legends|warlord]] and bandit who, in [[3 ABY/Legends|3 ABY]], terrorized the [[Moisture farmer/Legends|moisture farmers]] of [[Beheboth]] by raiding their [[Moisture farm/Legends|farms]] for every drop of [[Water/Legends|water]] they had and re-selling it on the [[Black market/Legends|black market]]. Longspar and his [[Brigand|gang]] accomplished this after discovering how to manipulate and control the [[Tirrith]], an empathic gaseous culture of hive-minded [[Sentience/Legends|sentient]] particles that became key to his scheme. However, local farmer [[Darial Anglethorn]] and her friend [[Luke Skywalker/Legends|Luke Skywalker]] joined forces with the vengeful Tirrith to defeat Longspar and destroy his operation.

==Biography==
{{Quote|The kid's come to rescue ya! He's a regular ''hero!'' Only I'm afraid he's gonna be disappointed! 'Cause ''I'' got plans for ya m'self, li'l lady, ya been a thorn in my side fer too long&mdash;an' yer about t'be ''plucked!''|Gideon Longspar, to Darial Anglethorn|<ref name="marvel66" />}}
[[File:Whadak.jpg|thumb|left|250px|Luke Skywalker knocks Gideon Longspar out cold.]]
Formerly a first-contact specialist<ref name="gamer7">{{GamerCite|7|Alien Anthology Addendum|''Alien Anthology'' Addendum}}</ref> who encountered [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]],<ref name="marvel66" /> Gideon Longspar had failed in his previous profession by [[3 ABY/Legends|3 ABY]],<ref name="gamer7">{{GamerCite|7|Alien Anthology Addendum|''Alien Anthology'' Addendum}}</ref> when he had come to lead a gang of [[brigand]]s on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Beheboth]]. Longspar encountered a unique creature called the [[Tirrith]], an empathic gaseous culture of hive-minded [[Sentience/Legends|sentient]] particles&mdash;after realizing the immense power that large groups of Tirrith had when joined together, Longspar captured a group of Tirrith and held them hostage to ensure the rest of the collective's cooperation in a lucrative new scheme. Beheboth was a desert world that had by that time not experienced [[Water/Legends|rain]] in many [[Standard year/Legends|years]], meaning water was extremely valuable&mdash;Longspar began a series of devastating raids on local [[Moisture farm/Legends|moisture farms]], using the Tirrith to put any defenders to sleep before taking every bit of water and reselling it for a fortune on the [[Black market/Legends|black market]].<ref name="marvel66" />

Operating out of a remote mountain base, Longspar and his gang successfully robbed a number of farms in the vicinity of the town of [[Prosperity (Beheboth)|Garrotine]], driving many of the locals to desperation. Longspar eventually took a crack at the largest moisture farm on the planet, in doing so kidnapping owner [[Darial Anglethorn]], who had taken a leading role in organizing farmers to defend their homes. In response, Anglethorn's friend [[Luke Skywalker/Legends|Luke Skywalker]]&mdash;a [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel]] officer stranded on Beheboth due to a damaged [[Starfighter/Legends|starfighter]]&mdash;stormed Longspar's stronghold himself, only to be captured and [[Prison/Legends|imprisoned]] along with Anglethorn. A vengeful Tirrith helped free Longspar's prisoners, and when Longspar attempted to waylay them with Skywalker's confiscated [[Lightsaber/Legends|lightsaber]], Skywalker instead maneuvered Longspar into accidentally destroying the Tirrith's [[Tirrith restraining globe|restraining globe]] and freeing the remainder of the culture. Skywalker then knocked Longspar out cold with a left hook, and Anglethorn followed by destroying Longspar's water tanks, wiping out his operation and ending the threat of his brigands.<ref name="marvel66" />

==Personality and traits==
{{Quote|Boy, I suggest ya watch yer tongue... while ya've still ''got'' one!|Gideon Longspar, to Luke Skywalker|<ref name="marvel66" />}}
A ruthless bandit without empathy for others, Gideon Longspar was both boastful of his achievements and personally lazy&mdash;Longspar did not believe in doing work that someone else could do for him instead. A cruel man willing to consign many to die in order to make a profit, Longspar was personally confident in his own abilities, believing that he could effectively use a lightsaber despite not having seen such a weapon in decades.<ref name="marvel66" />

==Behind the scenes==
Gideon Longspar appeared in [[Star Wars (1977) 66|''Star Wars'' (1977) 66]], written by [[David Michelinie]], illustrated by [[Walter Simonson|Walt Simonson]] and released in [[1982]].<ref name="marvel66" />
